messages.subject: dartRverse in undergraduate teaching
parts:
Hi all,

We have interest from a publisher in taking on our ebook Introduction to dartRverse.They have asked in particular if the eBook is being used for undergraduate teaching or has a potential to be used for undergraduate teaching.

I know we use it for undergraduate teaching at the University of Canberra and Matt McGee at Monash University uses it for undergraduate teaching. Are there any other instances you know of where the e-book is actually being used for undergraduate teaching? 

It can be either in your own classes or in classes run at your university by others. Please let me know so I can contact your or one of your colleagues for a letter of to that effect.

Best wishes,

Arthur
